sloka: दृष्टमेतन्महाबाहो क्षयं ते रोमहर्षणम् ।लक्ष्मणेन वियोगश्च तव राम महायशः ।। ७.१०६.८ ॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭametanmahābāho kṣayaṁ te romaharṣaṇam ।lakṣmaṇena viyogaśca tava rāma mahāyaśaḥ ।। 7.106.8 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed and greatly renowned Rama, this terrifying destruction and your separation from Lakshmana have been foreseen.
